Backend 41/42 pytest pass; the 1 failure is a real bug: comparison never works for basic report-level plans. Frontend flows all passed.

critical.issue: On basic report-level plans (e.g. batting-starter, combined-starter, academy-starter, QA player's plan) compare_previous=true NEVER shows a comparison. Instead it shows a wrong compare_note saying 'there's no earlier batting report from the same camera angle yet', even when an earlier comparable report exists. Root cause: load_report_for -> filter_report(level basic, lvl<1) sets every metric value to None BEFORE attach_view -> history_for -> report_view.comparable_history, so no rows match and it returns None. entitlements() still reports comparisons=True for these plans, and pricing shows 'Before/after comparisons' on Starter plans, so the upload page offers the checkbox. Reproduced: job 18864366... with compare_previous=true gives progress=None plus the wrong note on basic, and progress present on advanced.

minor.issue: Legacy jobs with no compare_previous field and report_level!='basic' default to want=True, so when there's no history they now get compare_note 'You asked to compare…' even though the user never asked. Only add compare_note when job.get('compare_previous') is True.

This code email uses its own note 'Only share this code if you consent. CricAnalyze staff will never ask for it.' and does NOT include 'Never share this code' as the review request expects. The wording arguably fits better. Confirm which is intended.

The QA player's legacy subscription plan_snapshot still reports max_duration_s=300 in entitlements. The upload hard cap of 25s still holds on server and client, but the value is inconsistent.

rca of the issue: Basic-level comparison: load_report_for() -> filter_report(rep,'basic') replaces metric values with None (status 'locked'); attach_view() then calls history_for(rep) on this filtered rep; comparable_history requires m['value'] is not None and status in SCORABLE for the current report, so rows=[] -> None -> the wrong compare_note. Repro: set compare_previous=true on job 18864366759e4e2c8da2978c8757105c (basic) and GET /api/analyses/{id}: progress=None plus the note. Set report_level=advanced and progress is present. Fix: build history from the raw db report before filtering, or disable comparisons for basic level.
